concepts.proposed_markdown: Credits and commits can restrict eligible usage with direct product IDs or tags for simple product or product-family filtering, or with `specifiers` for pricing-group values, presentation-group values, and advanced boolean logic. Direct selectors match when usage matches any listed product ID or tag; within a specifier fields are ANDed, while separate specifier objects are ORed. A pricing- or presentation-group condition cannot match a product missing the corresponding group key, and subscriptions and composite products do not carry those group values. [[source-metronome-guides-pricing-packaging-apply-credits-and-commits-target-credit-and-commits]]
warnings: Keep the missing-group-key and subscription/composite-product exclusion scoped to specifiers that use pricing or presentation group values.
